name: Saka (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Saka town emblem in white: a stylised disc of swirling strokes with a bird's head.
history: Municipal flag of Saka, a town in Hiroshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 20 November 1980.

features.role: Saka town emblem — a stylised disc of swirling strokes with a bird's head
